notes_for_editor: Very thin. Two catalogue lines give the county, coordinates, elevation and agency, and no history. A WebSearch found no fire tower on Jacks Creek Mountain in Walton County and no lookout called Pipeline. The NHLR Georgia list in the local cache does not show this site. The story stays near the 120-word floor and states once what no source describes. The name 'pipeline' is not explained by any source and is not interpreted. Needs GFC records or a local source before a fuller history is written.
